resources.string: PRELUDE+ works without an account or cloud synchronization. Your sources, favorites and watch progress are stored locally on your device.
What is stored on your device
What is sent off your device
URLs, sign-in details and provider settings
Sensitive sign-in details are encrypted with keys held by Android Keystore. They are not synchronized to a PRELUDE+ server.
They are used only for on-device features such as resuming playback and personalization. They are removed through the relevant settings, by clearing Android app data or by uninstalling the app.
Artwork, descriptions, EPG and temporary files
The cache keeps temporary data for faster operation and can be cleared without deleting your saved sources.
IPTV, TMDB, OpenSubtitles and Google Play
The app connects directly to sources you add. For metadata or subtitles, search details such as title, year, season and episode are sent to the relevant services.
Crash and ANR reports only after you choose

Collection is off by default. If you enable it or choose to send once, technical details such as an exception, stack trace, app version, device model and Android version may be sent to Firebase Crashlytics. We do not add source URLs, credentials, media titles, profiles or analytics events.
Some IPTV providers work only over unencrypted HTTP. In that case, the network may be able to see the address and traffic to the provider. Prefer HTTPS where supported.
The publisher legal name and privacy email have not been configured yet. They will be added before public release—false or temporary details are not used.
PRELUDE+ does not provide, host or sell television channels, playlists, subscriptions or audiovisual content.
Add only sources and content that you are legally authorized to access. You are responsible for legality, availability and compliance with your provider terms.
You are responsible for securing provider credentials, PINs and password-protected backups that you create or share.
IPTV providers, TMDB, OpenSubtitles, Google Play and optional Firebase Crashlytics are independent services. Their availability and practices are governed by their own terms.
Purchases are processed by Google Play. Price, taxes, receipts, refunds and payment-account management are controlled by Google and applicable law.
Streams, EPG, subtitles and metadata may be incomplete or unavailable because of the network, device or a third-party provider. We do not guarantee uninterrupted operation of third-party services.
Any material change to data practices or terms will include a new effective date and an updated policy version.
Catalog, EPG and stream delivery. Data goes directly to the server you selected.
Search for artwork, ratings, descriptions, cast and episode information.
Automatic or manual subtitle search and download based on the title identity.
Purchase processing, purchase restoration and Premium status.
Optional technical crash and ANR reports for diagnosing stability problems.
